title: Send a pay link
summary: Ask anyone to pay you online: a balance, a custom job or paying ahead. It goes straight to your bank.

steps.title: Make the link
steps.body: In Money, tap "Send a pay link". Or open a customer and send one for what they owe. Pick who it's for, type the amount (from ₦100) and a short note of what it's for, then tap "Make the link".

steps.title: Send it
steps.body: Tap "Send on WhatsApp" and it opens on your phone with the link ready, or copy it. They pay by card or transfer, and get a receipt.

steps.title: See when it's paid
steps.body: Pay links shows each one as Waiting until it's paid. You get a notification on your phone when it is, and it counts in your week's money, settling what they owed.

tips: Pay links need Get paid set up, like deposits.
